_comment: Public multi-tenant web instance (los-lms.bhodhix.com). Selected with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Web. The MySQL connection string is supplied at runtime via the ConnectionStrings__LosDb environment variable (point it at the separate los_lms_web database), NOT here. The desktop client build never uses this file, so its behaviour is unchanged.

Seed._comment: DemoTenant seeds one ready-to-use demo company + login on startup (idempotent). The credentials are meant to be handed out for the demo and are logged at startup; this is a throwaway tenant with no real data.
